name: EVA Airways Corp.
summary: EVA Airways Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the aviation business in Taiwan, Asia, Europe, Oceania, and the United States. The company involved in civil and general aviation transportation; wholesale and retail of medical devices; and manufacture, sales, and maintenance of aircraft, parts and engine. It also provides catering and food manufacturing; ground service at airports; sky shop; training; and air cargo entrepot services. In addition, the company offers ground handling, travel agency, and air cargo services. EVA Airways Corp. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
